clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, blood shards carry the power of the fallen boar god Agamaggan. Quilboar say his blood sank into the earth and hardened into red stones. At Camp Taurajo, the captive Mangletooth trades their power to the Horde for his own reasons.

Quilboar lore tells how Agamaggan fell ten thousand years ago in the War of the Ancients. His blood raised giant thorn mazes across the plains, then sank beneath the soil and seeped into minerals. In time, it hardened into blood-red stones. The quilboar honor the shards as sacred remnants of their creator. They gather them from mineral seams and holy grounds, then use them as totems for battle and sorcery.

Mangletooth is held in a cage at Camp Taurajo by the tauren. He bears a bitter grudge against his own kind, saying his tribe betrayed and cast him out. Without freedom or the magic of his people, he bargains with adventurers for blood shards. Their power lets him reach Agamaggan's magic despite his captivity and channel it to Horde champions. He takes pleasure in turning that power against the quilboar who rejected him.

Mangletooth speaks with reverence of Razorfen, the quilboar's holiest sanctuary to the south. The tribes say the vast briars of Razorfen Kraul and Razorfen Downs grew from Agamaggan's colossal skeleton and tusks. They believe Razorfen Downs lies within the demigod's gaping maw, a holy threshold that devours and crushes any who enter without the Boar God's favor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Along with the thorns, the blood affected other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems for strength in battle and as totems for their magics.
I know the secrets of that magic.
Bring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up!
Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you do understand. My words were not lost on your ears, traveler. Mangletooth may be caged, but no cage can stop Agamaggan's power!
The touch of the shard, the feel of it... It has been a long time, traveler.
Do you know what it is like? To have your power severed from you?
But, that is a tale for another time. I promised you information. I promised you Agamaggan's power. My people turned their backs on Mangletooth. Now, I lose you upon them.
